standard.summary: 训练使用的基础模型文件路径（.safetensors / .ckpt）或 HuggingFace model ID。所有 LoRA 权重都基于此模型进行适配。
standard.effect: 不同的基础模型决定了 LoRA 的底层特性和生成风格基础。SD1.5 / SDXL / Anima / Flux 等不同架构需要对应路线的训练配置。
standard.whenToUse: 每次训练必须设置。路径支持本地绝对路径和 HuggingFace Hub 的模型 ID。
standard.avoidWhen: 基础模型路径错误会导致训练立即失败（文件不存在或格式不匹配）。确保模型格式与 model_train_type 匹配。

standard_en.summary: The path to the base model file used for training (.safetensors / .ckpt) or a HuggingFace model ID. Every LoRA weight adapts on top of this model.
standard_en.effect: The base model decides the LoRA's underlying character and its stylistic foundation. Different architectures -- SD1.5 / SDXL / Anima / Flux -- need the training configuration for their own route.
standard_en.whenToUse: It has to be set for every run. The path accepts a local absolute path or a model ID on the HuggingFace Hub.
standard_en.avoidWhen: A wrong base-model path makes training fail immediately (the file does not exist, or the format does not match). Make sure the model format matches model_train_type.

advanced.principle: v2 = 是否是 SD 2.x 系列（影响 CLIP tokenizer 和 UNet 架构的选择）；base_weights/multiplier 允许在基础模型上叠加额外的初始权重（如先加载一个已训练的 LoRA 作为起点）；dim_from_weights 从预加载权重文件推断 network_dim；num_vectors_per_token 是 textual inversion 专用（每个 token 的嵌入向量数）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 从 HuggingFace Hub 加载需要网络连接（或预先下载缓存）；本地路径更可靠但需要手动管理文件。

advanced_en.principle: v2 = whether it is an SD 2.x-family model (affects the CLIP tokenizer and UNet architecture choice); base_weights/multiplier allow stacking extra initial weights on the base model (e.g. loading an already-trained LoRA as the starting point); dim_from_weights infers network_dim from the preloaded weight file; num_vectors_per_token is textual-inversion-specific (embedding vector count per token).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Loading from the HuggingFace Hub requires network access (or a pre-downloaded cache); local paths are more reliable but require manual file management.
